title: Code questions are answered from a pinned code map in one call, and a change names the docs and kb facts it makes stale, here and in a host project
goal: kbingest's map records each symbol's definition and references at a pinned commit; one call (CLI and kb MCP server) answers where a symbol is defined, who uses it and what depends on a package without reading files; and one call names, for a change since a revision, the docs a docs map ties to the changed files and the kb CODE facts that cite them, in this repository and in a project that installs the plugin; code-question lookups answered from the map are measured against reading files.
notes: Later, unrefined: symbols and references for languages other than Python through each language's read-only mapper commands (kb/public/agents/codebase-mapping.csv) or a language server's documentSymbol and references requests where one is installed, a language with neither left as a note in the map.
